active_view_definitions.analytics.v_active_cluster_genre_profile:
SELECT p.cluster_id,
    p.genre_name,
    p.mean_preference,
    p.n_users,
    p.model_version
   FROM analytics.cluster_genre_profile p
     JOIN analytics.model_registry r ON r.model_version = p.model_version
  WHERE r.is_active AND r.is_valid_for_dw;
active_view_definitions.analytics.v_active_user_cluster:
SELECT c.user_id,
    c.cluster_id,
    c.status,
    c.model_version
   FROM analytics.user_cluster c
     JOIN analytics.model_registry r ON r.model_version = c.model_version
  WHERE r.is_active AND r.is_valid_for_dw;
